correctness.rationale: For the ordinary 27-vertex K3 Cartesian three-cube, the weak-majority condition is induced same-class degree >=3. Direct independently reconstructed 27-bit adjacency and all sum_{k=1}^7 binom(27,k)=1,285,623 possible small class subsets yielded exactly 54 valid six-classes, no smaller/seven classes. They are the 54 3x2x1 coordinate boxes. Enumerating every disjoint triple of valid six-classes and testing the nine-vertex complement gave exactly 288 valid four-class partitions; the common full-length axis and class sizes (6,6,6,9) follow. Quotient rook graph counting gives 96 partitions per axis, with 24 line/72 L residuals, and original verifier explicitly constructs all 1296 graph automorphisms and computes 18,54,216 orbit sizes; all 288 times 4! =6912 onto named colorings. Complete exhaustion proves this fixed finite graph, not higher dimensions or the distance-two graph.
